coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Community Center Garage (UCSF Mission Bay)
record.summary: UCSF lists a 'Community Center Garage' at 1625 Owens Street among its Mission Bay campus parking options, and DataSF's official address point for 1625 Owens St lies inside this record's outline. No source read says when, by whom or how it was built; the May 2000 Regents item for the neighbouring community center says an interim parking lot would be built beside it 'until a parking structure can be built in a later phase'.

notes.accuracy_caveat: PARTIALLY REAL -- UCSF's June 2025 CAC map (updated December 2024) labels this 'COMMUNITY CENTER GARAGE (21A)' with a parking symbol and does not list it among the undeveloped parcels, which supports an existing garage here; the rooftop deck and painted parking-space striping are Pier & Point's own reading of satellite imagery (not cited or saved here), and this record's own boundary was traced as the leftover open ground between DataSF's official street lines and neighbouring mapped shapes, as seen in satellite imagery, not a surveyed building footprint or parcel line; DataSF's own Building Footprints dataset does not separate this garage from the Rutter Center building (both fall under one continuous footprint, mblr SF8709011), so there is no official boundary between 21A and 21B -- the dividing line used here is the Rutter Center's own real west wall, extended, which is a reasonable but not authoritative choice.
notes.digitized_from: Traced as the leftover open ground between DataSF's official street lines and neighbouring mapped shapes in the Owens St / Rutter Center area, as seen in satellite imagery; several pieces were chosen and combined by hand, not taken from a surveyed parcel. First added on 2026-09-20 as part of the neighboring Rutter Community Center record and split out into this separate record on 2026-09-22.

facts.value: Parking: UCSF lists it among its Mission Bay campus parking options; the page is undated

DataSF's official address point for 1625 Owens St (address ID 731845, parcel 8709011) lies inside this record's outline, 16.7 m from its nearest edge (Pier & Point's own calculation in a local metric projection). The Assessor lists one parcel, 8709011 ('1675 1625 Owens'), for the community center and the garage together, so the point places the address here but does not tell the garage apart from the center.

milestones.text: UC Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings item (May 17, 2000) for the Mission Bay community center building says an 'interim parking lot will be developed at the northwest corner of the building until a parking structure can be built in a later phase of campus development'; the item is about the community center, not the garage

changes.text: Added a sourced dossier for Community Center Garage.

The garage record said a real rooftop deck with painted striping was visible in satellite imagery, that it stood beside the William J. Rutter Community Center and was joined by a walkway, and that the area was the 1625 Owens St parking lot. UCSF's June 2025 CAC map supports only an existing garage labeled 'Community Center Garage (21A)' beside 'Rutter Center (21B)'. The record now says so, marks the rooftop deck, walkway and striping as Pier & Point's own satellite reading (not cited), drops the full Rutter Center name, and flags that the 1625 Owens St address is unsourced.

open_questions: When was the Community Center Garage built, and is it a multi-level structure? UCSF's parking page (undated) offers parking at 1625 Owens St, and the city's address point is inside the outline, but no source read dates its construction or opening.

STRUCTURE QUESTION: the May 2000 Regents item describes an interim parking lot beside the community center, to be replaced by a parking structure in a later phase. In UCSF's June 12, 2025 Mission Bay CAC figure (an image) the label 'COMMUNITY CENTER GARAGE (21A)' sits beside a flat, building-less parcel with a parking symbol, where it was viewed by eye, not as text. Whether a parking structure was ever built here, or the 'garage' is the surface lot, is not established. The geometry file's rooftop-deck reading comes from the project's own satellite review and is not corroborated by a document.

The Assessor's 2022 roll has one parcel (8709011, listed '1675 1625 OWENS') for the community center and the garage together, with no year built; a DBI permit search on block 8709 lot 011 returned only two unrelated permits (a street-space permit and a 2021 telecommunications-equipment alteration), so no new-construction permit for a garage was found.
Architect, builder, space count and operator are not found. UCSF's Parking and Transportation pages were not opened (blocked).
The garage is distinct from the 1670 Owens garage (DBI permit 200801243180, 823 spaces), which has its own record.
No UC Regents capital item for a community-center garage was located.

record.notes: A parking garage labeled 'COMMUNITY CENTER GARAGE (21A)' on UCSF's own Dec 2024-updated campus map (June 2025 CAC presentation, page 3), immediately west of the block that map labels 'RUTTER CENTER (21B)'. That it has a rooftop deck and is connected to the Rutter Center by a walkway is Pier & Point's own reading of satellite imagery, not stated on UCSF's map, and the building's full name and operator are not confirmed by a primary source.
